TCWV source gap affects 0 event-window observations; retained as NaN and skipped in composite means
0 observed window values have no monsoon calendar-day baseline (season edges); excluded from paired means
Precursor timing uses first pre-event crossing above calendar-day 75th percentile
Conditional probabilities: training-only percentiles, day counts and future onset counts verified for both populations
